liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Around And Around** (2 reviews, 2 other sources): Massive version, recommended listening; Jerry's MIDI use is heard through the long second set; The band wouldn't let it end [6][7][18][20]
- **He's Gone** (1 review, 2 other sources): Produces a great jam coming out of it; The stretch from 11:55 to 16:19 is a Garcia and Rhythm Devils jam [6][7][18]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (2 reviews): Unusually placed as the first-set closer; Expansive version that, with Ramble On Rose, closes the first set [16][24]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet into Fire runs about half an hour and is a favorite of the reviewer; Scarlet-Fire is overlooked, in reviewer's top five and favorite segue ever [16][23]
- **Blow Away** (2 reviews): Brent heats it up, swearing five or six times along the way; Hot version, with Brent going wild at the end [14][16]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Help>Slip>Franklin's judged one of the best ever; the tape was a long-time favorite audience source [24]
- **Just A Little Light** (1 review): Reviewer calls it their all-time favorite version of the song, sublime [14]
- **Knockin' On Heaven's Door** (1 review): Played as the encore [17]

## The recordings

- **gd90-06-15.sbd.ladner.8570.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 201 min; rated 4.22/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Good soundboard; Jerry's vocal is low in the PA for Help's first verse, then fixed, otherwise flawless; Decent sound; Jerry's vocals low in Help's first verse and a slight problem at Scarlet's start [14][21]
- **gd1990-06-15.sbd.ladner.tetzeli.fix-8570.35161.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 201 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1990-06-15.146936.photoLeon.MTX.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 206 min [6]
- **gd1990-06-15.146443.FOB.OTS.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 205 min [7]
- **gd90-06-15.naks.jill-rob.7762.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 199 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [9]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has crisp sound quality [17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended, having seen JGB at the Warfield the night before [17]
- Jerry was in the mood to stretch jams in set two; playing had some missed notes and harmonies [20]
- Reviewer's friends missed the start of Help, which settled a debate about arriving late [21]
- Reviewer says this Scarlet-Fire beats the Cornell version without question [23]
- Desolation Row shows a new edge, perhaps the seed of the great 7/19/90 version [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-06-15.sbd.ladner.8570.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHN [1]. Also: This soundboard uses an audience source for most of a set; reviewer has the complete show as a digital soundboard; Soundboard to DAT to CDR to WAV to SHN, with an audience patch; transferred and tracked by neolevo [1][22]
- **gd1990-06-15.sbd.ladner.tetzeli.fix-8570.35161.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 8570 [4]. Also: Audience patch at the end of disc 2 track 5 was lengthened and crossfaded before the drum set to join CDs 2 and 3; SHN files were converted to FLAC and SBE errors fixed with shntool [4]
- **gd1990-06-15.146936.photoLeon.MTX.t-flac16**: source: A photoLeon Matrix [6]. Also: Recorded by Dave Brotman and Jeff Metchick; Charlie transferred the Ultra Matrix cassette master; Jill and Rob R supplied the patch [6]
- **gd1990-06-15.146443.FOB.OTS.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick Master Digital Recording; transferred by Joe Noel and Charlie Miller; source: Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick Master Digital Recording: Set I: (FOB) Spaced Schoeps CMC4 MK4's > Oade Pre Amp > (-20db pad) > DAT (Panasonic SV255) Location:… [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Shoreline Amphitheatre, Jun 15, 1990 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/SHO900615.html) [26]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - June 16, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/june-16-1990) [27]
- Fan art by www.gdao.org: [T-shirt: "Shoreline Amphitheatre / Grateful Dead" skull. Back: "Shoreline Dead '90" · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Gra](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/276547) [28]
